title: Venser Crosses a Divergent Dominaria
summary: A journey through an alternate history reveals Venser's latent ability to planeswalk.
narrative: Temporal instability drew the travelers into another version of Dominaria whose past had taken a different course.
Venser's inventions alone could not explain or safely navigate the crisis. Teferi and Jhoira helped him recognize and use his own latent spark to return.
His first crossing signaled the emergence of a new kind of planeswalker: talented yet vulnerable, rather than an ancient, nearly omnipotent being.

The public Venser profile verifies that he eventually became a planeswalker, and Wizards' later design commentary confirms his intended transition from mortal artificer to a newly limited planeswalker. Neither article directly narrates this particular alternate-Dominaria crossing; the precise scene still requires comparison with the Time Spiral block novels.
